npm run client:format:check, client:analyze, client:test, client:verify:architecture, client:verify:plan, and client:contracts:test pass.
Scoped Better Plan validate --check-sources and check-labels pass for layout-management, and desktop/mobile child architecture criteria resolve against the same current contract files.
Desktop and mobile child final-validation Nodes are completed with profile-owned command/file evidence and scoped label/manifest checks.
npm run client:run:macos rebuilds and opens the current client; both profiles and representative destinations are inspected without exposing runtime data.

An independent verification subagent runs npm run client:build:android:debug and reports build, discovery, authorization, install, and launch statuses separately when an authorized phone is available.
Scoped validate --check-sources and check-labels pass for the foundation, desktop, and mobile plans; any unrelated full-workspace plan debt is reported without weakening layout evidence.
All four current profile identities and all eight surface bundles pass profile-owned behavior, adaptive, semantics, interaction, source-manifest, and frozen-design golden checks.
Pairwise dependency-closure and change-impact evidence proves that a source, fixture, asset, or golden change in any one profile cannot alter or import any of the other three profiles.

Representative Home, Agents, and Settings renders preserve the frozen current design on desktop and mobile while layout switching preserves semantic destination, selected conversation, draft, focus, and bounded profile state.

npm run client:run:macos rebuilds and opens the current client and all four layouts are inspected without exposing runtime data; independent Android verification reports build, device authorization, install, and launch statuses separately.
